title: vscode web / Additional browser setup
content:
## Additional browser setup

There are additional browser configuration steps you can take when working with {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} in a browser.

### Opening new tabs and windows

In certain cases, you may need to open a new tab or window while working in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} for the Web. {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} might ask you for permission to access the clipboard when reading from it. Depending on your browser, you may grant access to the clipboard or otherwise allow for pop-up windows in different ways:

* Chrome, Edge, Firefox: Search for "site permissions" in your browser's settings, or look for the following option in the address bar on the right:

![Allow clipboard access in the browser](images/vscode-web/allow-clipboard-access.png)

* Safari: In the Safari browser, go to **Preferences...** > **Websites** > **Pop-up Windows** > the domain you're accessing (for example, `vscode.dev`), and select **Allow** from the dropdown.
